subject: Mutual action plan & timeline — Helix AI onboarding
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@helixai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan & timeline — Helix AI onboarding

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the milestones, owners, target dates, and acceptance criteria for the Helix AI -> Redwood Inference integration and onboarding. The goal here is to give both teams a concise source of truth we can iterate on during planning.

Top-level asks:
- Confirm the kickoff call window (proposed: Thu, Jul 8, 10:00–11:00 PT).
- Review the milestones and owner mappings and call out any conflicts or missing stakeholders.
- Flag any compliance or procurement gating items that will affect the timeline.

Summary of key milestones (high-level):
1) Contract & SOW signed — Target: 2026-07-06 — Owner: Helix (Procurement) / Redwood sales
2) Kickoff & architecture review — Target: 2026-07-08 — Owner: Helix Eng / Redwood Solutions (Monica)
3) Network & VPC peering completed — Target: 2026-07-15 — Owner: Helix Cloud Ops / Redwood Eng (Ben)
4) Model validation & test dataset run — Target: 2026-07-22 — Owner: Helix ML / Redwood Research
5) Staged go-live (beta) — Target: 2026-07-29 — Owner: Helix Product / Redwood CS
6) Full go-live — Target: 2026-08-12 — Owner: Joint

I've put more detail and acceptance criteria into the attached spreadsheet (HelixAI_MAP_v1.xlsx). Please review and reply with any edits — I'll fold them in and circulate a v2. If the dates above look broadly correct, I'll book the kickoff on our calendars.

Attachment: [HelixAI_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)]

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 12:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & timeline — Helix AI onboarding

Grace, thanks — received and appreciate the clarity. Quick notes from our side:

- Overall this looks good. Procurement is moving quicker than expected (score for Redwood!). We can likely sign the SOW the week of 7/5 but need your commercial contact to confirm the final payment terms (we'll loop finance).
- Kickoff on 7/8 would work for our core team, but Priya (cc'd) asked if we can shift it to 7/9 if possible — they have an internal offsite on 7/8.
- For network/VPC work we need a list of required CIDR ranges and expected egress IPs to scope firewall rules. Can Redwood provide that prior to the kickoff?
- Acceptance criteria: for model validation we will need a sample of inference logs (redacted PII) and a short runbook for how Redwood validates output parity.

I'll attach the Helix machine-readable security questionnaire separately — procurement asked for it early.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Partnerships, Helix AI
liam.oconnor@helixai.com | +1 (617) 555-0129

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & timeline — Helix AI onboarding

Liam — great, thanks for the quick read. Quick replies inline and next actions below.

- SOW/payment terms: I'll loop in our commercial ops and ask them to provide the final commercial contact today. We should be able to target signatures by 7/6 with normal payment terms; I'll escalate if finance requires an exception.
- Kickoff: 7/9 works for Redwood as well. I'll update the draft MAP and keep 7/9 10:00–11:00 PT as proposed.
- Network info: see short stub below — Ben, can you confirm exact CIDR ranges and outbound IPs? We'll circulate a formal network spec before the call.

Redwood network stub (pre-kickoff):
- Client-to-Redwood egress: 10.32.0.0/18 (peer-to-peer VPC)
- Recommended firewall: allow 443 inbound from Helix egress ranges; specify TLS 1.2+
- Expected outbound IPs for callbacks: 34.200.11.45, 34.200.11.46 (subject to final infra assignment)

Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Model validation run: Redwood will run Helix test set (n=2,500 records) against the prod-config model; pass = no more than 3% RMS deviation over key labels + semantic check pass on 200 sampled items.
- Security checklist: Helix provides completed MRQ; Redwood to provide audit plan and log retention details (SOC2-related).

Next actions:
1) I will update MAP to v1.1 with the 7/9 kickoff and the network stub — grace to send by EOD today.
2) Ben to prepare network spec and integration checklist (attachment) — Ben, can you aim for EOD tomorrow 7/1?
3) Liam/Priya to confirm SOW sign date and any special procurement terms by 7/2.

Attachment: none in this message — will attach updated MAP in next email.

Best,
Grace

Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & timeline — Helix AI onboarding

Thanks — adding the implementation-level plan and checklist here. Attachment: helix_integration_checklist.pdf (11 pages). Highlights below.

Network & infra (owner: Ben / Redwood Eng)
- Final CIDR ranges: Redwood will accept a /24 from Helix for peering (example: 10.32.4.0/24). Final allocation TBD on kickoff.
- Egress IPs: currently scheduled: 34.200.11.45, 34.200.11.46. We'll confirm by 07/06 after infra tagging.
- Test connectivity window: 2026-07-15 to 2026-07-16 (NDA'd test window).

Integration tasks (owner, target):
- Provide integration SDK and example requests — Redwood (Ben) — 2026-07-10
- Helm chart / deployment sample for private deploys — Redwood (Monica) — 2026-07-12
- Shared runbook for model validation steps — Redwood + Helix — 2026-07-20
- Smoke test: 1,000 inference calls, latency and correctness capture — Helix (tech) / Redwood (ops) — 2026-07-23

Acceptance criteria (expanded):
- Stability: 99.5% of inference requests under the 500ms P95 latency during the smoke test window.
- Correctness: semantic parity on sampled items; any deviation >3% triggers remediation sprint and roll-back plan.
- Security: MRQ completed by Helix and baseline audit logs exchanged; DLP checks on sample logs before shipment.

Risks & mitigations:
- Procurement delay — Mitigation: Redwood to provide temporary test credits and sandbox access to begin early validation without SOW in place.
- Network ACL constraints — Mitigation: pre-shared firewall checklist and test window.

Attachment: [helix_integration_checklist.pdf (11 pages, doc stub)]

I'll upload a PDF and share a link after this mail. Grace — I'll be on the kickoff if scheduled 7/9.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (206) 555-0198
